description: Implementation of a DAO (Data Access Object) for accessing country data in a database, specifically providing a method to list countries based on language.

classes.name: CountryDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for accessing country data, extending generic DAO functionalities and providing specific methods like listByLanguage.

methods.name: listByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries associated with the provided language, using a query with a left join on descriptions and ordering by country description name.
